description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InteropAccountTransactionNotAllowedException' that extends a base exception class for domain rule violations within the Fineract platform. It is used to indicate that a transaction on a specific account is not permitted.

classes.name: InteropAccountTransactionNotAllowedException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a transaction on a particular account is not allowed.

methods.name: InteropAccountTransactionNotAllowedException
methods.description: Constructor that takes an account ID and constructs an exception message indicating the transaction is not allowed for that account.
